assertion.statement: Assuming the six specified statements G, M, H, PC, C and B for the actual templates, the saved P_star satisfies thm:target: its rational zero projection is ordinary Z, with292890231905 ambient variables, degree<tw7 and coefficient magnitudes<tw8.
assertion.objects: The one saved integer polynomial P_star, canonical codes for2E(Q(sqrt2))=Z P0, actual guarded multiplication and pole templates, and the fixed five-input natural polynomial.
assertion.hypotheses: G is exact canonical membership and addition; M is exact multiplication on every typed triple; H gives both separately used constant sets; PC supplies the specified pole witnesses; C gives natural computation and rational substitution semantics; B identifies the literal expression and its size calculation. Each requires its own proof.
assertion.quantifiers: For every q in Q, q belongs to ordinary Z iff there exist292890231904 rational witnesses with P_star(q,w)=0.
assertion.parameter_range: All rational inputs, including nonintegers; witness variables for the natural compiler are natural before its rational model translation.
assertion.uniformity: One polynomial and one set of fixed templates works for all inputs. No family-dependent replacement is permitted.
assertion.constants: Ambient count292890231905; degree strictly below tw7 and absolute coefficient strictly below tw8, with tw1=2 and right-associated towers.
assertion.normalizations: Ordinary embedded Z in Q, not merely an abstract Diophantine model; one shared shift and disjoint private witness blocks; integer coefficients.
assertion.exceptional_cases: The proof must retain identity/opposite code cases, every typed multiplication triple and its finite false-triple guard, zero/negative/nonintegral inputs, and the inverse guards in the literal construction.
assertion.limit_order: First establish G/M/H/PC/C/B for the actual templates, then apply the ordinary-value bridge and literal substitution, and finally the same-expression size bounds.
